exact_hypotheses: G is a group, Gamma is the right-coset geometry of indexed H0,H1,H2, and sigma in Aut(G) cyclically permutes those subgroups. No order bound on sigma is stated.
exact_conclusion: There exists an incidence-preserving correlation of order exactly three cycling the three types.
proved: The induced map cycles the types and preserves incidence; it has order three exactly when Hi sigma^3(g)=Hi g for all i,g. All six explicit finite witness automorphisms satisfy sigma^3=1.
not_proved: The existence of some other order-three correlation under the unqualified hypotheses.
not_a_disproof: The C9-square normalization counterexample is not a coset geometry: its full typed group has two orbits on incident pairs of a given pair of types. Every coset geometry has a transitive coset-group action on such pairs.
next_exact_obligation: Prove the bare existential conclusion, or supply an actual coset geometry satisfying its hypotheses with no order-three type cycle. A failed induced-map proof alone does neither.
